summary: Smoke test of imported USP India CMS on preview URL. Backend: 27/27 pytest pass (health, public site/pages/notes, media images, enquiry submit->admin list->delete, bot/honeypot rejection, cookie login + CSRF enforcement, admin list endpoints, note create/update/delete persistence). Frontend: all public pages render (/, /about, 4 Our Work children, /field-notes, /connect) with no broken images; header nav works; the Field Notes reader overlay (?note=slug) and direct /field-notes/:slug both work; Connect form submits and shows a success message, and the enquiry appears in Admin > Enquiries; admin login, dashboard, Pages, Field Notes, Media, Menus, Settings, Enquiries, Appearance, SEO and Users all load with no 4xx/5xx or page errors; changing a draft note title in the UI, saving and reloading kept the change, and it was then reverted. No blocking bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Anonymous public visitors trigger 401 on /api/auth/me and /api/auth/refresh (console noise from live-editor session check) - expected behaviour, not a bug.
routes_admin.py is ~870 lines (above the 700-line guideline) - optional refactor, not blocking for an as-is deployment.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ enquiries and a TEST note were created and deleted; the draft note title was edited and reverted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Field notes open in an overlay via button[data-testid^=note-link-] (not anchors). Admin writes need x-csrf-token header = csrf_token cookie plus Origin. Enquiry needs elapsed_ms>=2500 and topic in TOPICS. The rate limit is 5 enquiries per IP per hour. pytest.ini forces xdist; use -n 0 for a serial run.
